tool_schemas.name: summarize_youtube_video
tool_schemas.description: Ingests the referenced YouTube video (by youtube_video_id or source_url), ensures it is available for processing, and returns a cached or newly generated Gemini summary using the requested model and generation settings. Returns the summary artifact and associated metadata for the video; if force_regenerate is false and a matching artifact already exists, we return the cached result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither youtube_video_id nor source_url is provided, if both are provided but inconsistent, or if model_id fails the required format; raises NOT_FOUND if the video cannot be resolved/ingested or the specified model_id does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to use the service or model, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed generation limits.

youtube_video_id.description: YouTube video ID to ingest and summarize (e.g., 'dQw4w9WgXcQ').

source_url.description: Full YouTube URL for the video to ingest and summarize.

model_id.description: Model catalog id to use for generation.

prompt_version.description: Prompt template/version identifier to use for summarization.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate for the summary.

force_regenerate.description: If true, bypass cached artifacts and create a new generation job.

tool_schemas.name: ask_about_youtube_video
tool_schemas.description: Ingests the referenced YouTube video (by youtube_video_id or source_url) and returns a cached or newly generated Gemini answer for the provided question, or a general description when question is omitted. Returns the answer artifact plus video metadata; if force_regenerate is false and a matching artifact already exists for the same inputs, we return the cached result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither youtube_video_id nor source_url is provided, if both are provided but inconsistent, or if model_id fails the required format; raises NOT_FOUND if the video cannot be resolved/ingested or the specified model_id does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to use the service or model, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed generation limits.

youtube_video_id.description: YouTube video ID to ingest and query.

source_url.description: Full YouTube URL for the video to ingest and query.

question.description: Question to answer about the video; if omitted, returns a general description.

model_id.description: Model catalog id to use for generation.

prompt_version.description: Prompt template/version identifier to use for Q&A.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate for the answer.

force_regenerate.description: If true, bypass cached artifacts and create a new generation job.

tool_schemas.name: extract_key_moments
tool_schemas.description: Ingests the referenced YouTube video (by youtube_video_id or source_url) and returns a cached or newly generated set of key moments (timestamps with short descriptions) produced by Gemini using the requested model and generation settings. Returns the key-moments artifact plus video metadata; if force_regenerate is false and a matching artifact already exists, we return the cached result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither youtube_video_id nor source_url is provided, if both are provided but inconsistent, or if model_id fails the required format; raises NOT_FOUND if the video cannot be resolved/ingested or the specified model_id does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to use the service or model, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed generation limits.

youtube_video_id.description: YouTube video ID to ingest and extract key moments from.

source_url.description: Full YouTube URL for the video to ingest and extract key moments from.

model_id.description: Model catalog id to use for generation.

prompt_version.description: Prompt template/version identifier to use for key-moment extraction.

max_output_tokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate for the key moments output.

force_regenerate.description: If true, bypass cached artifacts and create a new generation job.

tool_schemas.name: list_supported_models
tool_schemas.description: Lists Gemini models available in YouTube Vision’s model catalog, optionally filtered by provider, status, and default-ness, and returns results paged with limit and an opaque cursor (pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page). Returns an array of model records and a next-cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if provider/status are not one of the allowed values or if limit/cursor are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to access the catalog, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if you exceed read limits.

is_default.description: If set, filter to default (true) or non-default (false) models.

limit.description: Maximum number of models to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: list_videos
tool_schemas.description: Lists ingested videos in YouTube Vision, optionally filtered by status and/or YouTube video id, and returns results paged with limit and an opaque cursor (pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page). Returns an array of video records and a next_cursor when more results are available. Refuses invalid filters and does not return rows marked deleted unless explicitly requested.

youtube_video_id.description: Filter by the YouTube video ID (e.g., 'dQw4w9WgXcQ').

created_after.description: Only return videos created after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

created_before.description: Only return videos created before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination; pass the prior response's next_cursor to continue.

tool_schemas.name: get_video
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single video record by id and returns its stored metadata and transcript fields. Refuses requests for unknown ids.

tool_schemas.name: create_video
tool_schemas.description: Creates (or idempotently returns) a video record for a referenced YouTube video. Accepts either youtube_video_id or a full source_url; when created, the video starts in status='new' unless status is explicitly set to 'deleted'. Refuses invalid or conflicting identifiers.

source_url.description: Full YouTube URL for the video to register.

status.description: Initial status for the video; use 'deleted' to create a tombstone that prevents processing.

tool_schemas.name: update_video
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a video and can drive supported lifecycle transitions. Setting status to 'ingesting' triggers transcript acquisition; setting to 'deleted' cascades to mark related artifacts deleted and prevents new generation jobs for the video. Refuses illegal status transitions and rejects attempts to modify immutable fields.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the video; must follow allowed transitions.

language_code.description: BCP-47 language code for the transcript (if known/overridden).

transcript_text.description: Transcript text to store for the video (overrides existing transcript when provided).

tool_schemas.name: list_generation_jobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists generation jobs (summary, Q&A, key moments) optionally filtered by video_id and/or status, and returns results paged with limit and an opaque cursor. Returns an array of job records and a next_cursor when more results are available. Refuses invalid filters.

video_id.description: Filter jobs to a specific video.

job_type.description: Filter by the type of generation job.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination; pass the prior response's next_cursor to continue.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity associated with the presented API credential, including granted scopes and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Refuses missing/invalid credentials.

api_key.description: YouTube Vision API key used to authenticate the request.

metadata.name: YouTube Vision
metadata.description: YouTube Vision stores ingested YouTube video metadata plus derived artifacts generated by Gemini (summaries, Q&A answers, and key moments). The main workflow is: a client references a video, the system ensures the video is ingested/transcribed, runs model jobs to generate artifacts, and returns cach
